name: lowness
quote: I wish my co-worker would grow up some.
description: Perception that someone's behavior is harmless, but outside the bounds of normal thought or behavior in a gross or silly way to the point of risking their status as a serious person.
perceptions: That person is not taking this situation serious enough.
They'd be better off acting their age.
results: Perhaps eye-rolling, gossip, or just avoiding them.

guidance.description: Navigating inappropriate jokes can be tricky, and the decision to respond or let it go depends on several factors, including context, audience, and your own comfort level.

commentaries.quote: Most of the time we carefully curate the dignity of important identities. Sometimes a dash of silliness can be a part of that equation.
Children have one kind of silliness, as you know, and grown-ups have another kind.
